[[Bon Secours Wellness Arena]] |champion = SoCon regular-season and [[2023 Southern Conference men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions |tourney=[[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second round }} {{2022–23 Southern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Furman Paladins men's basketball team''' represented [[Furman University]] in the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Paladins, led by sixth-year head coach [[Bob Richey]], played their home games at [[Timmons Arena]] and [[Bon Secours Wellness Arena]] in [[Greenville, South Carolina]] as members of the [[Southern Conference]] (SoCon). They improved on their 12–6 [[2021–22 Southern Conference men's basketball season|SoCon]] record from last season and finished the regular season with a 15–3 record, to finish in first place. In the [[2023 Southern Conference men's basketball tournament|SoCon tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 Mercer Bears men's basketball team|Mercer]]{{Cite web |last=Caskey |first=Jordan |date=2023-03-04 |title=Furman Turns Up The Heat On Mercer, 73-58; Paladins Advance To Semis With School-Record 25th Win |url=https://furmanpaladins.com/news/2023/3/4/mens-basketball-furman-turns-up-the-heat-on-mercer-73-58-paladins-advance-to-semis-with-school-record-25th-win.aspx |access-date=2025-03-24 |website=Furman University |language=en}} and [[2022–23 Western Carolina Catamounts men's basketball team|Western Carolina]] to reach the championship game.{{Cite web |last=Caskey |first=Jordan |date=2023-03-05 |title=Furman Survives Western Carolina To Notch Record 26th Win, Advance To SoCon Finals, 83-80 |url=https://furmanpaladins.com/news/2023/3/5/mens-basketball-furman-survives-western-carolina-to-record-26th-win-advance-to-socon-finals-83-80.aspx |access-date=2025-03-24 |website=Furman University |language=en}} In the championship game, they defeated defending SoCon tournament champion [[2022–23 Chattanooga Mocs men's basketball team|Chattanooga]] to make the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], the first time since 1980 they accomplished this.{{Cite web |last=Caskey |first=Jordan |date=2023-03-06 |title=CHAMPIONS!!! Furman Tops Chattanooga To Claim SoCon Crown, NCAA Berth, 88-79 |url=https://furmanpaladins.com/news/2023/3/6/mens-basketball-champions-furman-tops-chattanooga-to-claim-socon-crown-ncaa-berth-88-79.aspx |access-date=2025-03-24 |website=Furman University |language=en}} They went on to upset [[2022-23 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball season|Virginia]] in the first round of the NCAA tournament,{{Cite web |last=Caskey |first=Jordan |date=2023-03-16 |title=Furman Works Magic In Orlando; Paladins Shock Virginia In NCAA First round, 68-67 |url=https://furmanpaladins.com/news/2023/3/16/mens-basketball-furman-works-magic-in-orlando-paladins-shock-virginia-in-ncaa-first-round-68-67.aspx |access-date=2025-03-24 |website=Furman University |language=en}} only to lose to the eventual national runner-up [[2022–23 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] in the second round.{{Cite web |last=Caskey |first=Jordan |date=2023-03-18 |title=San Diego State Stops Furman's NCAA Tournament Run, 75-52 |url=https://furmanpaladins.com/news/2023/3/18/mens-basketball-san-diego-state-stops-furmans-ncaa-tournament-run-75-52.aspx |access-date=2025-03-24 |website=Furman University |language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Furman Paladins men's basketball team|Paladins]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 22–12, 12–6 in [[2021–22 Southern Conference men's basketball season|SoCon play]], to finish in second place. They defeated [[2021–22 Mercer Bears men's basketball team|Mercer]]{{Cite web |last=Paré |first=Julie |date=2022-03-05 |title=No. 2 Furman Eliminates No. 7 Mercer, 80-66, to Advance to SoCon
